registry_note_en: These are navigation links for you to open and verify. The prototype does not query, scrape or automate any portal. Link URLs are from the build specification; page content was not scraped or re-verified during the build.
registry_note_hi: ये आपके लिए खोलकर सत्यापित करने के नेविगेशन लिंक हैं। प्रोटोटाइप किसी पोर्टल को क्वेरी, स्क्रैप या स्वचालित नहीं करता। लिंक यूआरएल बिल्ड विनिर्देश से हैं; निर्माण के दौरान पृष्ठ सामग्री को स्क्रैप या पुनः सत्यापित नहीं किया गया।

sources.title: IRDAI — Health Insurance Department
sources.purpose: Official regulator page for health-insurance context. Open it to check current public guidance.
sources.notes: URL supplied in BUILD_PLAN.md. The app does not fetch or scrape this page. Re-check current wording before relying on it.

sources.title: Bima Bharosa — FAQ and grievance route
sources.purpose: Official grievance FAQ. Use it to understand the current complaint route and eligibility information.
sources.notes: The app does not submit a complaint. Bima Bharosa does not ask complainants to pay to resolve a grievance.

sources.title: Bima Bharosa portal
sources.purpose: Official grievance portal link for the user to open and verify the current process.
sources.notes: Link only. The app does not implement automated filing, scraping or portal interaction.

sources.title: IRDAI — List of insurer Grievance Redressal Officers
sources.purpose: Find the insurer's official Grievance Redressal Officer contact route.
sources.notes: Link only. The app does not verify or store GRO contact details.

sources.title: Council for Insurance Ombudsmen
sources.purpose: Official Ombudsman information. Check current eligibility and process yourself.
sources.notes: The prototype does not decide Ombudsman eligibility or calculate deadlines.

sources.title: Common Landing Portal for Unclaimed Financial Assets
sources.purpose: Official starting point to look for unclaimed financial assets across participating institutions.
sources.notes: The app has not searched this portal. A transaction clue is not proof of an unclaimed asset.

sources.title: RBI UDGAM — Unclaimed Deposits
sources.purpose: Official RBI portal for searching unclaimed deposits with participating banks.
sources.notes: The app has not searched this portal and does not claim it contains any record for the user.

sources.title: Investor Education and Protection Fund Authority (IEPFA)
sources.purpose: Official information about unclaimed dividends, shares and related investor protection routes.
sources.notes: Link only. The app does not query IEPFA records or decide whether any amount is due.

sources.title: SEBI Investor Website
sources.purpose: Official investor-education and grievance-navigation information for securities-market matters.
sources.notes: Link only. The app does not query SEBI systems or provide investment advice.

sources.title: Sarvam AI — Open-weight API documentation
sources.purpose: Provider documentation for the optional Sarvam open-weight chat API.
sources.notes: Optional provider. The app works fully without Sarvam and does not send user content to it. Model availability can change.

sources.title: Sarvam AI — Model status
sources.purpose: Provider model list and status page. Check current model IDs before enabling Sarvam.
sources.notes: The app does not hardwire a model ID. The deprecated legacy sarvam-30b API model ID is not used.

sources.title: DPDP Rules — government backgrounder
sources.purpose: Public background material on the DPDP Rules notification. Not legal advice or a compliance certification.
sources.notes: The prototype is not certified as compliant with any law or regulation. Real deployment needs legal and privacy review.
